typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		TrailerRow as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select  \'TRL|\' + (SELECT RIGHT(\'0000000\'+ISNULL(CAST(COUNT(*)  as varchar),\'\'),7)  + \'|\'   FROM ReverseSync.MemberList WHERE [SubscriberID] NOT IN    ( 	SELECT DISTINCT SubscriberID FROM [ReverseSync].[MemberList] 	WHERE ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM([ListBillGroupNumber])),\'\') = \'MULTGROUP\'   ) ) as TrailerRow',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetTrailerRecord
GetTrailerRecord sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = TrailerRow)) ~> FlatFileDestination
